headline: RBI issues Urban Co-operative Banks KYC Second Amendment Directions, 2026
reference: Reserve Bank of India (Urban Co-operative Banks - Know Your Customer) Second Amendment Directions, 2026
summary_points: RBI has published the Urban Co-operative Banks (Know Your Customer) Second Amendment Directions, 2026 on its Notifications page.
The directions amend the existing KYC Directions applicable to Urban Co-operative Banks (UCBs).
The page text available does not set out the specific amendments, issue date or effective date.
The full text is available as a 238 kb PDF attached to the notification on the RBI website.
who_is_affected: Urban Co-operative Banks and their customers, along with compliance and audit teams handling KYC and onboarding.
action_required: Read the full directions on the RBI website to identify the amended KYC provisions and effective date, then update UCB KYC policies and procedures accordingly.

RBI has issued the Reserve Bank of India (Urban Co-operative Banks - Know Your Customer) Second Amendment Directions, 2026.

The directions amend the existing KYC framework applicable to Urban Co-operative Banks (UCBs). The notification is available as a PDF on the RBI Notifications page.

The page text we reviewed does not list the specific changes, the date of issue or the effective date, so the details should be taken from the full document.

Why it matters:
- UCBs may need to revisit their KYC policies, onboarding and periodic updation procedures.
- Compliance, internal audit and risk teams should map the amendments to current processes.
- Advisors to co-operative banks should brief clients once the changes are confirmed.

We will cover the specific provisions as they are confirmed.

Please verify the details with the official RBI source before acting.
